workflows.title: Profile setup
workflows.blurb: Guided onboarding: import a CV, a documents folder, or answer an interview. Re-run one section with --section.

workflows.title: Discover jobs
workflows.blurb: Searches installed portal CLIs (or WebSearch when none), deduplicates, and stores new postings.

workflows.title: Rank matches
workflows.blurb: Fetches each new posting, runs the integrity gate, scores it with the upstream rubric, and returns a shortlist.

workflows.title: Application Studio
workflows.blurb: Drafter → reviewer → revision. Evaluates fit, asks before drafting, compiles and verifies the PDFs.

workflows.title: Record outcome
workflows.blurb: Updates an application's status, archives what was sent, drafts follow-ups (never sends).

workflows.title: Interview prep
workflows.blurb: Stage-specific prep pack from the archived posting and your documents; roleplay on request.

workflows.title: Gmail sync
workflows.blurb: Reads application emails through the claude.ai Gmail connector and proposes status changes for approval.

workflows.title: Notion sync
workflows.blurb: One-way push of ranked jobs and applications to a Notion database. Local files stay authoritative.

workflows.title: HTML report
workflows.blurb: Generates a self-contained offline dashboard from the tracker and archives.

workflows.title: Profile enrichment
workflows.blurb: Finds competency evidence in your documents, GitHub or portfolio; confirms before writing.

workflows.title: Skill gaps
workflows.blurb: Compares tracked postings with your profile and builds a prioritised learning plan.

workflows.title: Add template
workflows.blurb: Registers a custom CV or cover-letter template and its compile command.

workflows.title: Add portal
workflows.blurb: Generates a portal-search skill for a job board, checked by the upstream security guard.

workflows.title: Reset profile
workflows.blurb: Resets candidate profile data back to templates. Destructive: it shows what will change and asks first.
